title: Fizzy Orange Sherbets
description: Fizzy, juicy orange lollies with bicarbonate of soda for a sherbet-like kick — like a frozen Dip Dab. Great for kids on a sunny day.
steps: Measure the orange juice into a large jug. Add the caster sugar and whisk thoroughly.
Add the bicarbonate of soda a little at a time and watch it fizz — be careful not to let it overflow. Whisk until combined.
Leave for 15–20 minutes to let the fizzing subside.
Decant into 6 lolly moulds, filling about three-quarters full. Freeze for at least 4 hours.
notes: Makes 6 lollies. Save for a balmy afternoon.
